guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: cartservice_socket is the strongest non-error anomaly (+63.3%, z=+12.66), with memory (+35.7%) and CPU (+30.4%) also elevated, while the downstream services in the service map (shippingservice, currencyservice, productcatalogservice) show flat or lower load. The weak points are that cartservice appears in no trace or call-graph edge, logs are empty, and the sampled error traces show errors only in frontend (plus one paymentservice trace), so the link between cartservice and the frontend error rate of about 55% is inferred rather than observed.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect cartservice's open connections and connection pool for leaks or exhaustion, check how frontend calls it, and raise limits or fix the leak. Verify the diagnosis by pulling cartservice traces and logs before any restart.
